summary: Nix research program phase 6 after a dive wave: one opus agent harvests the new consolidations, appends the landing report to the topic map, applies the stop condition, and commissions the next wave (revised staged briefs plus follow-ups) or declares ready-to-draft with binding authoring notes
logs: Verdict: needs-another-round · rerun 4 · next wave 4 · IDs 101 · MUST 60 · families 6 · contradictions 18

harvest.verdict_reason: Wave 3 added 21 MUST rules (INP 4, PKG 11, REL 6), and the wave-2 reruns added 3 more (FLK-19, GEN-19, GEN-20). It also added four new failure classes: C19 ignored declaration, C20 diagnostic drift across versions and implementations, C21 untrusted data interpolated into a builder, and C22 broken evidence. NIX-LANG, NIX-SEC and NIX-MOD still have no consolidation, including the P0 rows M-C-07 and M-H-01..03. Several load-bearing questions can be answered now: ocx has not been built end to end; GEN-02/04/05 are MUST with no red twin; the handoff prototype breaks GEN-11/17/20; PKG-07 conflicts with GEN-14 for D; lazy fetching decides INP-02's severity. The wave-plan stop condition is not met.

frame_corrections: H2 sharpened: follows is decided by how an input is consumed, and the Nix manual itself calls a transitive nixpkgs 'usually irrelevant'. The lock never dedups by content: 3 byte-identical pins give 4 nodes (NIX-INP-01). Library flakes leak test inputs into consumer locks (NIX-INP-02; NixOS/nix's nixpkgs-regression inside nix-installer's lock).
